reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about passive film behavior, repassivation kinetics, and coupled degradation mechanisms for CoCrFeMnNi in chloride solution, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific alloy-environment-wear interactions claimed here.
premises: CoCrFeMnNi forms a protective passive oxide film in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution
Mechanical wear can remove the passive film faster than repassivation occurs
Film removal exposes bare metal and accelerates localized corrosion
Tribo-corrosion degradation exceeds the sum of pure wear and static corrosion
